dataHandling: Anonymous aggregate counts, totals and ranked volume distribution only. No production identifiers, names, PRN numbers or payload data are retained.
knownSnapshotLimits: The PRN values represent endpoint-eligible completed-year 2025 data and deliberately exclude cancelled and rejected PRNs.
The generator applies the completed 2025 PRN shape to its local 2025 POM / 2026 obligation-year journey.

The fixed ranked PRN counts cover the observed top 20 organisations; the remaining generated POM submitters receive the residual volume evenly. The source has 440 eligible PRN holders, while the retained POM model has 311 submitters.
NumberOfDaysObligated is intentionally null until an explicit determination-record option is added.
